add-subtract-20-skill-01.target: I can add within 20 by making a ten, using doubles, or counting on.
add-subtract-20-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add within 20 by making a ten, using doubles, or counting on.
add-subtract-20-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting on from the smaller number and losing count, or forgetting part of the second number after making ten. Try this: Fill a ten frame first, then add the leftover counters in a second frame.

add-subtract-20-skill-02.target: I can subtract within 20 by counting back, going back to 10, or thinking addition.
add-subtract-20-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can subtract within 20 by counting back, going back to 10, or thinking addition.
add-subtract-20-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Subtracting the smaller ones digit from the larger one (14 − 6 → 12). Try this: Ask “6 plus what makes 14?” and jump to 10 first on a number line.

add-subtract-20-skill-03.skill: Adding in Any Order and Adding Three Numbers
add-subtract-20-skill-03.target: I can change the order of addends and add three numbers by finding a ten first.
add-subtract-20-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can change the order of addends and add three numbers by finding a ten first.
add-subtract-20-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking 3 + 8 and 8 + 3 have different answers, or leaving out one of three addends. Try this: Turn the domino around; it has the same dots. Circle two addends that make 10.

add-subtract-20-skill-04.target: I can use an addition fact to solve a related subtraction fact.
add-subtract-20-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use an addition fact to solve a related subtraction fact.
add-subtract-20-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing a subtraction fact that starts with a part (6 − 14 = 8). Try this: Use a part-part-whole mat: in subtraction the whole comes first.
